==== model: Faramir the Judicious ====

$likelihood
Dv ~ dlnorm(mu, sigma[Mg])

$main_model
mu <- loga[Mg] + gamma * (Mo - 1) + yr_eff + lo_eff + tr[Tr] * 
    sigma_tr + b_deg * deg_h_z + b_precip * precip_72h_z + b_seq * 
    seq_depth_z

$gamma_def
gamma <- s_conv + gap_shift * (Mg - 1)

$prior_loga
loga[Mg] ~ dnorm(5, 2)

$prior_s
s_conv ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_gs
gap_shift ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$pr_sigma
sigma[Mg] ~ dhalfnorm(0, 1)

$yr_eff_def
yr_eff <- yr1 * (Yr == 1) + yr2 * (Yr == 2) - (yr1 + yr2) * (Yr == 
    3)

$prior_yr1
yr1 ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_yr2
yr2 ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_deg
b_deg ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_precip
b_precip ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_seq
b_seq ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_tr
tr[Tr] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$pr_sigma_tr
sigma_tr ~ dhalfnorm(0, 1)

$lo_eff_def
lo_eff <- lo1 * (Lo == 1) - lo1 * (Lo == 2)

$prior_lo1
lo1 ~ dnorm(0, 1)

attr(,"name")
[1] "Faramir the Judicious"
